articles.title: Swedish fugitive arrested as new OTF GRIMM targets added to EU Most Wanted
articles.summary: The arrested individual, a man in his 30s linked to the Foxtrot network, was wanted by Swedish authorities for murder, preparation, and conspiracy to commit murder. He was suspected of playing an active role within an organised crime group, including the recruitment of individuals to carry out violent acts. The arrest was carried out by Tunisian authorities following long-term cooperation...

articles.title: Outcome Evaluation of Los Angeles County’s Juvenile Justice Client Assessment Recommendation and Evaluation (CARE) Program
articles.author: Laura Whitaker
articles.summary: This report evaluates Los Angeles County’s CARE Program, a holistic juvenile defense model. The evaluation finds benefits in quality of life, case dispositions, and county cost savings, while identifying staffing, data, and coordination challenges.
articles.analysis: La evaluación del programa CARE en Los Angeles aporta evidencia sobre justicia juvenil restaurativa pero su aplicabilidad europea requiere adaptación contextual.

articles.title: Russian Private Military Companies May Become a Security Threat to Their Hosts in Africa
articles.summary: Russian private military companies, now more aligned with the Kremlin's agenda and less focused on profit and equipped with a full suite of subversive capabilities, could help steer their African hosts away from the U.S. and impede African progress toward economic prosperity.
articles.analysis: RAND identifica amenazas de PMCs rusas en África pero subestima su rol en facilitación de rutas de narcotráfico transaharianas hacia Europa.

articles.title: Gamification of Narrative Language and Grassroot Cognitive Warfare
articles.summary: Recognition and rapid mastery of cognitive warfare tactics such as gamified narrative language will become increasingly important for the United States in the years ahead. The next conflict may open with a fierce exchange of deprecating narratives and gamer slang instead of bullets and missiles.
articles.analysis: El análisis de RAND sobre guerra cognitiva gamificada aborda narrativas pero omite su aplicación práctica por redes criminales para reclutar y operar.
